programme.desc: 由中宣部港澳台新聞局指導立項的大型紀錄片愛在灣區，共分為 11集，由香港主持人黃庭鋒在大灣區各個城市包括廣州深圳珠海佛山惠州東莞中山江門肇慶香港及澳門，實地走訪，深入了解平凡人物背後的故事，展現人物的真實生活，客觀呈現大灣區日新月異的發展圖景，生動講好灣區精彩故事，全面展現灣區蓬勃活力藉此體現灣區堅守一國之本，善用兩制之利，助推港澳融入國家發展大局

programme.title: 好劇連場: 沉默的榮耀
programme.desc: 諜戰劇沉默的榮耀，真實歷史的震撼再現！劇集首次以真實姓名真實事件，將一段幾乎被時代塵埃掩埋的壯烈史詩以電視劇形式再度呈現，劇情跌宕起伏，扣人心弦ampampampampltbrampampampampgt當所有人享受著革命勝利的果實見證新中國成立的時候，有一群人，放棄了安逸的生活，在白色恐怖的籠罩下，以丹心為炬，照亮了歷史的漫漫長夜39集電視連續劇沉默的榮耀以前所未有的視角，將鏡頭對準了這些在台灣隱蔽戰線上的無名英雄，以深沉細膩的敍事手法，在語言風俗及生活場景中融合閩台文化元素，呈現台灣島在上世紀五十年代的面貌，讓觀眾彷彿穿越回到那個動盪的年代ampampampampltbrampampampampgt沉默的榮耀根據真實歷史人物吳石朱楓陳寶倉聶曦等烈士的事蹟改編，創作歷時七年，講述1949年至1950年，中共代號｢密使一號｣的台灣國防部中將參謀次長吳石，與中共華東局女情報員朱楓國防部中將陳寶倉副官聶曦等人緊密配合，多次將機密軍情傳遞給共軍，之後遭出賣而被捕吳石在牢房中用鮮血寫下台灣必歸四個大字，四人最終以為中共從事間諜活動被判死刑伏法ampampampampltbrampampampampgt此劇集結了國劇一線的實力派演員與經驗豐富的幕後團隊由盧敏為總編劇，楊亞洲執導，于和偉吳越魏晨曾黎等領銜主演憑藉強勁的製作班底，頂級演員的精湛演繹，此劇在國內開播後引發廣泛關注9月30日於央視8套開播，首日收視率破3，還曾連續18天創大陸收視第一官方宣傳該劇為獻禮國慶大劇，是新中國成立以來首部反映台灣隱蔽戰線鬥爭的重大主題影視作品

programme.desc: 節目以獨特的樹説視角，深度聚焦柏木槐樹桑樹榕樹銀杏五種深深烙印在中國人生命圖譜中的樹種，歷經四季流轉，穿行20個省市自治區，在時空交織中展開一場跨越千年的文明對話，讓觀眾從一棵樹的生命歷程中，讀懂中華文化的源遠流長中國歷史的厚重深沉中華民族的精神品格本節目由ampampamplt湖南快樂陽光互動娛樂傳媒有限公司ampampampgt贈播

programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.desc: 함께 하는 대한민국을 위한 EBS 사회 공헌 프로그램

programme.title: 모여라 딩동댕
programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 로보카 폴리
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 어린 철학자
programme.desc: lt어린 철학자gt는 정답을 맞히는 아이가 아니라, 자신만의 생각을 가진 아이로 자라도록 돕는다. 질문하고, 사유하고, 자신의 기준을 세우고, 주장할 줄 아는 인간으로 성장하는 시간! AI 시대, 대체 불가능한 인간이 되는 가장 근본적인 힘 - 철학 하는 힘을 키운다.

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 세계테마기행 1부
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 세계테마기행 2부

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: 너의 이름은.
programme.desc: 도쿄 소년 타키와 시골 소녀 미츠하는 자꾸 몸이 뒤바뀐다. 이런 일이 반복되자 서로 규칙을 만들어 행동하던 어느 날, 미츠하가 타키의 휴대폰에 남겨놓았던 흔적들이 모두 사라져버린다. 이를 이상하게 여긴 타키는 기억을 되짚어서 그녀가 살던 마을로 향하지만, 그 마을은 3년 전 혜성 충돌로 인해 이미 사라져버린지 오래. 타키는 참사 당일의 미츠하와 다시 몸을 바꿔서 마을을 구조하는 계획을 세우게 되는데...

programme.title: 보이스
programme.desc: 소리를 단서로 사건을 해결하는 소리추격 스릴러 우리가 목숨걸고 지킨 3분은 누군가의 인생이다! 상담원이라는 별명으로 불리며 가장 변방으로 취급 받지만, 사실 삶과 죽음을 가르는 가장 긴박한 순간들이 모인 112 신고센터 3분 도착, 5분 현장 확인, 10분 검거의 긴박한 타임 리밋 속에서 범죄현장의 골든타임을 사수하는 112 신고센터 대원들의 치열한 기록을 생생하게 담아내고, 우리 인생의 골든타임, 결코 포기해서는 안되는 그 순간의 용기에 대해 이야기한다.

programme.title: 대한민국을 바꾼 법의 탄생 : 헌법을 말하다
광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 로보카 폴리 시즌1
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 파파독
programme.desc: 늘 사랑스럽고 씩씩한 골목대장 별이. 하지만 그런 별이도 가끔은 쓸쓸한 모습을 보일 때가 있다. 그 이유는 별이의 가장 친한 친구이자 든든한 보호자가 되어 주었던 아빠가 해외 출장을 갔기 때문인데... 오늘도 홀로 가방을 챙기고 학교로 향하는 별이, 그런데 왠 개 한마리가 앞을 가로 막는다. 별이를 보며 반갑다는 듯 꼬리를 흔들던 개! 갑자기 두발로 일어나더니 사람처럼 말을 하기 시작하는데... 별아, 내가 니 아빠다, Im your farther! 어이없는 상황에 눈이 휘둥그래진 별이, 그리고 감정이 북받치는 듯 눈물을 흘리는 개! 과연 어떻게 된 일일까?? 배꼽 잡는 소동과 따뜻한 가족의 사랑이 담긴, 아빠가 개가 됐어요!, 개 변신 애니시트콤 파파독의 이야기가 시작된다.

programme.title: 요괴워치
programme.desc: 아주 평범한 동네, 진달래 마을에 사는 엄청 평범한 초등학교 5학년 민호는 어느 여름 날 기묘하고 하얀 생물인 위스퍼와 만나게 된다. 민호를 따라다니던 위스퍼는 신기한 시계 요괴워치를 민호에게 건네고.. 그날부터 마을 곳곳에 나타나는 요괴들이 보이기 시작한다! 일상 생활에서 벌어지는 곤란한 사건의 모든 것은 요괴가 원인이다?! 민호는 사건을 일으키는 요괴들을 설득하고 때때로는 싸우며 사건을 해결한다. 그리고 요괴들과 친구가 된다! 오늘은 또 어떤 새로운 요괴를 만나게 될까?

programme.title: 파파독
programme.desc: 늘 사랑스럽고 씩씩한 골목대장 별이. 하지만 그런 별이도 가끔은 쓸쓸한 모습을 보일 때가 있다. 그 이유는 별이의 가장 친한 친구이자 든든한 보호자가 되어 주었던 아빠가 해외 출장을 갔기 때문인데... 오늘도 홀로 가방을 챙기고 학교로 향하는 별이, 그런데 왠 개 한마리가 앞을 가로 막는다. 별이를 보며 반갑다는 듯 꼬리를 흔들던 개! 갑자기 두발로 일어나더니 사람처럼 말을 하기 시작하는데... 별아, 내가 니 아빠다, Im your farther! 어이없는 상황에 눈이 휘둥그래진 별이, 그리고 감정이 북받치는 듯 눈물을 흘리는 개! 과연 어떻게 된 일일까?? 배꼽 잡는 소동과 따뜻한 가족의 사랑이 담긴, 아빠가 개가 됐어요!, 개 변신 애니시트콤 파파독의 이야기가 시작된다.

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 大漢天子III
programme.desc: 雄主登巔野心不減 帝國極盛暗藏風雲步入中年的漢武帝，稱帝二十餘年，驅伊稚部落於漠北，削諸藩而一統，富國強兵，使大漢王朝進入了輝煌鼎盛時期 永不滿足的漢武帝，不斷設計自己的人生藍圖他聯合西域，穩定北疆，再無後顧之憂；又將目光轉向南越，意在建成最強大的大漢王朝在一批股肱之臣紛紛下世後，武帝大膽起用漢室新一代棟樑，他們抱著新的理想，摩拳擦掌欲展開年輕一代的故事同時，武帝痛感到光陰催人，理想遠大而天不永年，對長生不老的追求也越來越急迫

programme.title: 楚喬傳
programme.desc: 南北朝西魏年間亂世混戰，大批平民在戰亂中淪為奴隸，命如草芥奴籍少女楚喬被送入人獵場供貴族娛樂射殺，幸得燕北世子燕洵與宇文玥暗中相救，隨後她被帶進權傾朝野的門閥宇文家目睹兄姐相繼慘死，立誓要帶妹妹逃出牢籠楚喬受到開明貴族宇文玥關注，被迫接受嚴厲訓練的同時，更與燕洵結下深厚友誼西魏門閥爭鬥，燕洵一家滿門被滅，深陷絕境，楚喬與他生死相守併力助他逃脫困局然而回到燕北後，燕洵野心膨脹，不惜以滿城百姓性命為代價割據稱雄楚喬在絕望中與燕洵分道揚鑣，並與力求天下一統釋奴止戈的宇文玥並肩作戰，粉碎了燕洵的復仇計劃，成為心懷蒼生的巾幗將軍權臣宇文泰也在良臣勸諫下釋放奴隸，荼毒數百年掠民為奴的暴政至此終結

programme.title: 三國

programme.desc: 經典韓劇賢內助女王姊妹作黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 英雄訣
programme.desc: 燕王朱棣從小就表現出驚人的毅力和膽識，是眾兄弟中最出類拔萃的一個，但因為不是長子而無緣太子位太子朱標意外亡故後，朱元璋立皇孫朱允炆朱棣被削藩逼得無路可退，無奈起兵，在長達四年的靖難之役後，終於入主京師朱棣擁有了天下，卻背上了千古罵名，也失去了心中的摯愛朱棣用後半生的勵精圖治改寫大明的歷史，營建紫禁城，遷都北京，五次親征漠北，編成永樂大典，派遣鄭和下西洋，建立了不朽功績當他最後一次徵北時病逝於凱旋的歸途中

programme.title: 上陽賦
programme.desc: 皇權腐朽，貴族奢靡，不顧百姓生死郡主王儇，與初戀三皇子子澹青梅竹馬，卻因預言得之得天下，被捲入朝堂爭鬥，成為父親的一顆棋子，嫁給出身寒門的豫章王蕭綦大婚之夜，蕭綦被迫離開京城，王儇蒙羞，心灰意冷賀蘭王子綁走王儇向蕭綦尋仇，夫妻二人因禍得福相知相愛王儇被蕭綦守護天下子民盛世太平的心願感動二人因王謝兩族爭權太后陷害致夫妻流落分離兩人歷經萬苦重聚，滅叛軍，平邊境賀蘭族之亂在叛將謀反時，王儇拼死將無心皇位的子澹護送出京，保他平安王儇帶兵守城，九死一生，終於堅守到邊境平亂的蕭綦趕回最終，夫妻倆攜手開創新紀元，共同守護家國百姓

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 蒼穹之昴
programme.desc: 該劇以甲午戰爭至戊戌政變這一段時期為大背景，講述了一個靠撿拾街道上冰凍的牛糞馬糞維生的窮小子春兒，遇到了占星師白婆婆，白婆婆説他是天上的昴宿星降生，他的命與乾隆秦始皇一樣，未來將盡取中國一切財寶納入囊中她的預言，支撐着苦命的春兒活下去，當他兄長死於飢餓後，他自閹入宮，經過一番奮鬥與賣命，成為慈禧太后身邊的大紅人，接替李蓮英之位，白婆婆的語言似乎真的應驗了，然而他卻不經意地被捲入政治的漩渦

programme.title: 黑幫啟示錄
programme.desc: 尚坤不顧父親的勸阻加入幫派，過著流氓生活當他的老大因詐取幫派的錢而被革除時，尚坤便晉升成了新的老大他夢想著美好的未來，但一名手下卻意外捲入麻煩，不僅把他們全拖下水，連家人也因此過得很辛苦尚坤深感懊悔，掙扎著想擺脫過去，但由於過去的種種行為，他最終只能迎來悲劇

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: 重案組探員家駒不滿上頭釋放重犯朱滔，憤而辭職偕女友阿美出遊，恰巧遇到炸彈狂徒犯案，恐嚇接二連三，目標直指警局，警方不知所措，唯有重召家駒歸隊負責此案狂徒多番出動皆未得手後，竟起意綁架阿美以威脅家駒，家駒拼死直搗賊巢，不料貨倉已安裝炸彈

programme.title: 畫皮：情滅
programme.desc: 東海龍女阿若詐死留在凡間，和前世因救她而遁入凡世的王生成婚然而狐妖覬覦阿若體內可讓妖成人的叱玄靈葉，用計害死王生，使阿若情急之下用靈葉替王生續命少了靈葉的阿若無法抑制體內被封印的妖帝，命在旦夕，王生更被狐妖迷惑，心碎的阿若一面抵抗妖帝，一面與狐妖對峙，掙扎著保護變心了的王生

programme.title: 至尊無上
programme.desc: 羅森（譚詠麟飾）與螃蟹（劉德華飾）是情同手足的職業賭徒應龍哥邀請，兩人赴美國賭城破解了以日本人宮木父子為首的國際老千騙局，並結識了正在賭城度假的香港千金童可人（陳玉蓮飾），羅森更與她相戀三人回香港後，宮木太郎為了報復，雇香港黑幫人士追殺羅森羅森得螃蟹相救逃過一劫，但是螃蟹的左手卻也因此受傷，只好黯然退出江湖

programme.title: 至尊無上II之永霸天下
programme.desc: 凡獲賭神金牌，必可得其相助擁有一金牌之范老大因被大徒弟Tommy出賣而慘死，小徒弟希望剛出獄的二師兄杰對付Tommy，但遭拒絕後Tommy為尋賭神金牌而苦苦相迫，杰終忍無可忍，決清理門戶

programme.title: 父子武狀元
programme.desc: 公安鞏偉瞞著妻兒混入犯罪集團臥底，並為辦案需要丟下病重的妻子和兒子小固，到香港經悍匪小黑介紹而獲黑道大哥賞識香港女督察方逸華前往北京調查鞏偉的身份，與鞏固漸生感情，在其母病逝後帶小固赴港尋父然警方卻以小固為餌欲引出鞏偉，鞏偉因而與方逸華交戰小固則被小黑救走，卻又被犯罪集團挾持，鞏偉和方逸華雙雙前往營救，與匪徒爆發一場激鬥

programme.title: 六扇門22-24首

programme.title: 捉妖記
programme.desc: 某天，一對神祕夫婦與懷有小妖王的妖后逃到永寧村，遇上了善良的天蔭以及降妖少女小嵐，天蔭更陰錯陽差下成為代理孕夫誕下小妖王胡巴葛千戶重金懸賞小妖王小嵐為了得到賞金，拉著天蔭展開了一段奇幻旅程可愛的小妖王胡巴出生，令天蔭和小嵐關係起了奇妙變化，同時也揭發了一個重大祕密

programme.title: 門徒
programme.desc: 阿力用了八年時間，從一名小小的毒品批發商混到壟斷海洛英市場的莊家身旁，負責處理出貨及運輸工作多年以來阿力全心全意搜集完整販毒資料，但行事小心的莊家從未透露後來莊家萌生退休之意並意欲交棒給阿力接管，於是帶阿力到金三角，對阿力做出接棒前的最後試探，一場鬥智的過程，使阿力獲得莊家的絕對信任，阿力也漸漸掌控經營販毒的秘密

programme.title: 暗戰
programme.desc: 劉德華在片中飾演罹患癌症只剩下4星期生命的華，劉青雲則是飾演警察談判組談判專家何尚生，兩人展開了一場72小時鬥智鬥膽的遊戲杜琪峯以其最擅長的警匪片手法執導劉德華憑藉這部電影拿下個人第一座香港電影金像獎最佳男主角獎

programme.title: 記憶大師
programme.desc: 知名作家江豐正面臨與妻子張代晨的婚姻危機，為了不讓自己沉浸在過往，江豐來到了記憶醫療中心欲將過往的回憶取出，沒想到妻子卻要求他將記憶取回才願意離婚重新取回記憶的江豐，卻發現腦海中竟出現一場殺人回憶，江豐像是被捲入深不可測的陷阱中但，這份記憶真的正確嗎？

programme.title: 太陽不會動
programme.desc: 秘密組織AN集團為了防堵旗下特務出賣公司，於是祭出心臟炸彈手段一旦超過24小時他們未回報總部任務進度，就會被炸得粉身碎骨頂尖菁英鷹野一彦與火爆新秀田岡亮一搭檔，奉命至保加利亞出任務正當陷入苦戰之際，埋在鷹野體內的心臟炸彈倒數啟動時間一分一秒流逝，面對各方陰謀與死亡威脅襲捲而來，他能即時回報任務，看見明天的太陽嗎！？

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: 精武門弟子陳真（李小龍 飾）趕回上海奔喪，對師父霍元甲神祕死亡感到悲痛這時，日本武社突然派人送來東亞病夫匾額且出言不遜，氣得他將日本人打得落花流水，並當日本人的面一腳踢碎匾額日本武社懷恨在心而威脅精武門，精武門不得已將陳真逐出師門

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒四人在西行的路上，白骨精為奪唐僧巧設圈套，遭悟空識破因而受挫白骨精再設局，讓唐僧誤會悟空濫殺無辜，將其逐出師門，白骨精則趁虛而入，擄走唐僧悟空聞訊前往營救，與白骨精逆天決戰

programme.title: 古董局中局
programme.desc: 來自日本的木戶加奈小姐即將歸還中國一尊唐代武則天時期的明堂佛頭，指明要文物界組織五脈旗下白字門許家後人出面接收有著一身鑒古天賦的許家後人許願，在黃煙煙勸說下，他不情願的前往交涉，卻敏銳地察覺到佛頭是贗品許願本想逃避，然而面對重重迷霧和威脅，已是身不由己他必須要在各方勢力的糾纏之下，查明真相

programme.title: 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: 歷史系教師康森貴（黃百鳴飾）的前世開心鬼朱秀才一直陰魂不散地跟隨著康左右，康女友安妮（楊寶玲飾）的表哥（曹查理飾）對安妮情有獨鐘，視康為眼中釘；但康有朱的暗中保護，常常化險為夷，笑料連篇清兵元帥楊喪昆（劉洵飾）因對一良家女子（貌似安妮）起了邪念，被推下山崖，死在洞中；青年學生Behind組合（Beyond）在一次意外中將他的盔甲帶回學校，誰知他的鬼魂附於盔甲上，從此學校亂成一團

programme.title: 本日公休
programme.desc: 阿蕊開了四十年的男士家庭理髮，面對生活的煩擾，阿蕊總是以台灣歐巴桑的精神面對人生有天阿蕊接到一通電話，搬到遠方的老客人生病無法出門剪頭髮，拜託阿蕊到府服務阿蕊想起師傅教她這一行要服務客人到底，於是掛上本日公休的牌子，她要出發去做一件所有人都認為不值得的事

programme.title: 大顯神威
programme.desc: 保坪宮第十八代師公王富貴（豬哥亮飾），人稱豬哥仙，實際上逢賭必輸，輸到攜家帶眷南下投靠有錢妹婿（黃明志飾），不料妹婿中風，王富貴因緣際會認識保坪宮第十八代繼承人龍老大（李李仁飾），還誤打誤撞遇見了美豔女鬼晴霞（安心亞飾），從此時來運轉，但請鬼拿藥單，總要付出代價的原來，晴霞30年前曾經是紅透半邊天的歌姬，卻為愛香消玉殞，含冤遊蕩在陰陽兩界這次找上豬哥仙，要他大顯神威，解開塵封多年的謎底

programme.title: 甜蜜殺機
programme.desc: 資深刑警王志毅辦案效率奇差，卻天生有閃避危險任務的神準第六感警察署長的女兒高依萍一心想當警察，擔心愛女安危的署長靈機一動，下令王志毅與她搭檔，兩人水火不容，更被分配到調查可愛小狗死亡這種輕鬆差事沒想到這樁案件竟誤打誤撞，讓兩人追查到了警局通緝要犯的下落，更牽扯出一串驚天動地的謀殺案！

programme.title: 自由協議
programme.desc: 七年前，賽德為了替死去的兄弟報仇，與哥本哈根黑幫開戰後入獄警方向賽德提出交換條件，要求賽德成為哥本哈根黑幫臥底，以換取獲釋機會為了與日漸疏遠的7歲兒子修復關係，賽德同意了警方的條件，卻逐漸意識到作為黑幫臥底，也同時嚴重危及兒子的生命安全

programme.title: 烽火連天
programme.desc: 一名年輕女子齊蘭，為了尋求遭伊斯蘭國殺害的亡兄蹤跡而回到故鄉，然而故鄉已不復過往的和諧，社會動盪和政治局勢都升級到戰爭狀態人民站起來要求民主，卻遭到政府的無情鎮壓這起抗爭持續多日，齊蘭不願成為沉默的見證者

programme.title: 好萊塢幕後解密新
programme.desc: 好萊塢幕後解密新

programme.title: 神鬼獵殺
programme.desc: 世界知名富豪溫氏集團創始人尼里歐離奇墜海溺斃，他的死訊導致跨國經濟體系受到衝擊，更引起溫氏集團繼承人的明爭暗鬥沒有親人的尼里歐早在30年前就收養了一個小男孩羅格溫奇，秘密訓練他成為有勇有謀的精英，也是唯一的合法繼承人羅格溫奇在繼承前的第一個難題，就是洗清自己遭人誣陷入獄的冤屈

programme.title: 終極殺陣2：雷霆霹靂
programme.desc: 飆速計程車重現江湖啦！丹尼爾初次與岳父母共進午餐，適逢日本國防部長出訪法國，身為國防部長的岳父必須親自到機場迎接，丹尼爾的首要任務就是在飛機降落之前將岳父平安送達機場不料順利完成任務後，警探好友艾米里再度擾局，原來日本國防部長竟被恐怖份子綁架了！為了搶救日本國防部長並挽回法國的國際形象，艾米里只好再度請出飛車駕駛丹尼爾協助破案！

programme.title: 終極殺陣3
programme.desc: 12月的馬賽街頭，新式搶匪聖誕老公公肆虐，前兩集僥倖成功的響尾蛇和忍者行動，讓到處出包的警察局長又發想了新的無厘頭計畫，霹靂計程車司機丹尼爾添了更瘋狂的高科技新配備，準備和烏龍警探艾米里聯手衝向地中海飆上阿爾卑斯山，與難纏的聖誕搶匪們軋出個勝負；就在此時性感神秘的中國女子秋出現了！感情即將開花結果的艾米里，是否也因此陷入了意想不到的桃色危機？！

programme.title: 終極殺陣：最後衝刺
programme.desc: 隨著孩子出生長大家計吃緊，廢材警探艾米里決定接下史上最艱難的任務－－押解國際恐怖份子到南非，不得不求助老拍檔丹尼爾共度難關正當兩人認真商討對策時，小兔崽子們也沒閒著，闖禍本領更勝老爸，蠟燭兩頭燒的兩人，這下不僅要身兼奶爸，還要阻止法國淪為國際笑柄！

programme.title: 環遊世界大冒險
programme.desc: 這是史上最傳奇的冒險故事，英勇的麥哲倫與意外結識的艾爾卡諾毅然踏上環遊世界的旅程，並從此改變了歷史兩人帶領船隊經過了各個大陸島嶼，在遙遠神秘的島嶼發現了珍貴的香料和稀奇古怪的動植物，也經歷許多生死一瞬間的危險，面對飢餓暴風雨充滿敵意的原始部落，究竟麥哲倫能否成功環繞世界一周，顛覆人們的傳統觀念呢？

programme.title: 黑盒線索
programme.desc: 一架從杜拜飛往巴黎的班機，在阿爾卑斯山不幸墜毀一位年輕又才華洋溢的法國航空事故調查人員馬修，被指派為這起空難的首席調查員這是駕駛失誤？還是技術故障？或是恐怖攻擊？當這起調查結案時，馬修開始懷疑證據發生問題當他再度聆聽黑盒子的內容時，竟發現一些嚴重干擾的細節黑盒子的磁帶是否遭到修改？而他對真相的痴迷與追求，是否又會因為違背上級命令，讓他的生命遭到威脅？

programme.title: 危機倒數
programme.desc: 美伊戰爭時期，被派至伊拉克擔任拆彈隊長的詹姆斯雖然經驗老到，在一次任務中卻因他的堅持，意外讓隊友們陷入死亡絕境，小隊中開始出現反彈聲浪不久後的一場突襲任務出現一名自殺炸彈客，詹姆斯才意識到，自己的一舉一動將無法逆轉地改變身邊每一個人的命運；命懸一線的隊員，該如何從全世界最危險的戰地平安回家？榮獲奧斯卡最佳影片及最佳導演等六項大獎

programme.title: 星光首映場加菲貓：農場大冒險
programme.desc: 加菲貓過著舒服的家庭生活，某天竟突遭綁架，加菲貓與牠的狗狗夥伴歐弟，與失散多年的父親放蕩不羈的流浪街貓維克意外重逢，壞壞貓咪金珂絲因不滿維克的背叛而策劃綁架，並脅迫加菲貓前往農場偷取牛奶，補償金珂絲的損失，加菲貓只好連同歐弟維克進行風險極高又充滿滑稽的牛奶偷竊行動！

programme.title: 寒冬戰士
programme.desc: 密科拉是個和平主義者，希望可以對人類有所貢獻當戰爭在他所居住的烏克蘭頓巴斯爆發，激進分子殺了他的孕妻，將房子夷為平地，他的世界瞬間崩塌從悲憤平復後，密科拉入伍參加狙擊連當他遇見殺害妻子的兇手時，經過一番激戰，雙方陣營兩敗俱傷，密科拉雖被指導員救出，指導員卻不幸身亡此事令密科拉耿耿於懷而深感內疚，當他再度接到新任務的通知時，也已準備好這次要犧牲自己的性命

programme.title: 老公不是人首
programme.desc: 老公不是人首

programme.title: 拳力一搏
programme.desc: 一個高利貸業者因傳統營業模式已逐漸式微，開始計畫調整自己的生活，然而當地警察仍緊迫盯人，而他自身的病痛也越來越嚴重最終他決定在退休的前一天，進行一件不可能的行動，若是成功，他就能擺脫最後的煩惱，埋葬黑暗的過去

programme.title: 記憶迴瀾
programme.desc: 自出生就成為孤兒的尚恩，為了保護妻子和襁褓中的孩子免受其犯罪雙重身份的危害狠下心拋棄了他們接著他做了一件令人匪夷所思的事：偷竊了在巴黎一直庇護他的毒梟丹特毒梟沿路追捕將他引向法國西海岸，尚恩希望能在那裡找到一位船長，協助他非法逃離法國然而，這趟倉惶的逃亡之旅卻再次揭開傷痛的過去並將他推回他所逃避的父親角色

programme.title: 玩命光頭
programme.desc: 三個深陷頂上煩惱的男子，為了重拾往日風采，決定前往土耳其進行俗擱大碗的植髮任務人生地不熟的三人，就此展開一場瘋狂冒險之旅！

programme.title: 庫德行動
programme.desc: 完成大學學業後回到家鄉，錫昂親眼目睹村莊遭到焚燒和一系列的暴行，最終導致他加入了庫德族人的抵抗運動，並在與土耳其軍隊的衝突中受到嚴重傷害

programme.title: 玩命左輪
programme.desc: 傑克是個逢賭必勝的職業賭徒，讓賭場與對手聞之喪膽他與擔任會計的兄弟比利接到賭場老闆馬恰的邀約，天不怕地不怕的傑克，不但狠狠贏了馬恰一把，還在牌桌上羞辱馬恰，令顏面盡失的馬恰祭出追殺令此時傑克卻被醫生診斷出只剩三天壽命的怪病，而兩個殺手為了保護資產反倒成了保鏢，傑克要如何利用剩餘的時間和手上的爛牌完成最後奇招？

programme.title: 極限遊戲
programme.desc: 被構陷入獄的凱柏（傑瑞德巴特勒飾）在極不情願下，成為流行文化界的超級英雄：全球數百萬粉絲每週上網爭相看他在科技天才肯尼卡索（麥可霍爾飾）所發明的超暴力線上遊戲天地逃殺中，和其他數百位受刑人，為求活命而真槍實彈廝殺有些人不以為然地斥責這款遊戲是利用高科技來奴役他人的傷天害理行為，而驍勇善戰的凱柏，自然成為他們心目中，唯一能撂倒卡索的關鍵人物

programme.title: 特務殺很大
programme.desc: 一名罹患絕症的特務，接到組織交付的機密任務，該任務可以換取搶救他生命的藥物，但他一直隱瞞家人的特務身份也將被揭穿為了活命，特務不惜在巴黎殺出一條血路

programme.title: 美國天堂
programme.desc: 1951年，匈牙利陷入軍閥割據的全民恐慌，從事出版的彼得與瑪姬夫婦名列清算名單，他們逃亡至美國，卻無法帶走小女兒蘇珊平安抵達後，瑪姬不斷寫信向美國政府求情，只盼見到女兒全家團圓蘇珊由鄉間一對好心夫婦撫養長大，這天，城裡的奶奶要帶蘇珊進城玩，蘇珊將搭上飛往美國的班機，那裡有苦心企盼與她團聚的親生父母與嶄新生活小小年紀的蘇珊沒得選擇，美國不是她的家；她的心，始終遺留在遙遠的匈牙利

programme.title: 湯姆克魯斯：永遠的巨星
programme.desc: 湯姆克魯斯是1980年代好萊塢的指標性人物，雖然曾經歷職業生涯低谷，但他靠著搏命演出，重回演藝事業高峰，在這個充斥著超級英雄和奇幻系列電影的娛樂世界，湯姆克魯斯獨樹一幟，邁入演藝圈四十年的他，再次憑藉不顧生命危險的演出，成為票房之王，以此奠定他在娛樂圈甚至整個流行文化中不可取代的地位

programme.title: 逃出封鎖線
programme.desc: 二戰期間，一支德國坦克軍隊正在向莫斯科前進兩架戰機奉命前往阻止德軍進犯，空軍隊長尼古拉康姆列夫被迫降落在敵軍領地，歷經千辛萬苦後成功返回祖國，但也因傷送醫性命垂危他究竟是否能甦醒展開全新生活，迎接等待他的國家與戀人呢？

programme.title: 絕命6小時
programme.desc: 退伍海軍陸戰隊員克里斯的妻子被墨西哥販毒集團首腦綁架，克里斯隻身前往墨西哥營救，卻面臨一個可怕的困境：刺殺六名競爭對手，否則將永遠見不到妻子然而，當克里斯發現他摯愛妻子的秘密時，他將會如何抉擇？六個小時，六條人命，沒有規則！

programme.title: 革命前夕的摩托車日記
programme.desc: 這是切格瓦拉成為傳奇革命英雄之前的故事23歲的醫學院學生埃內斯托格瓦拉與生化學家好友阿爾貝托，跳上老舊的重機，從家鄉布宜諾斯艾利斯出發，展開一場貫穿南美大陸的壯闊之旅，目睹了這片土地所承受的創傷苦難與種族剝削，在青年格瓦拉的心裡埋下了日後改造世界的革命之火本片入圍金球獎最佳外語片，由中央車站巴西大導華特沙勒斯執導

programme.title: 諜報飛龍
programme.desc: 三位懷抱理想的科學家創立銀河黨，欲創造一個和諧世界，他們以控制天氣來恐嚇全球順應理想，若不從便將其港口城市淹沒各國領袖齊聚美國商討對策，其特務卻一一被滅口，而電腦分析出唯一能勝任反恐任務的特務，唯有一名我行我素的麻煩人物：德瑞克弗林特美國總統親自熱線下令，弗林特憑藉一身絕技與高科技秘密武器，最終直搗黃龍摧毀銀河黨

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 朋友再見
programme.desc: 自阿爾及利亞戰場歸來，法國醫官巴宏和外籍軍團傭兵波普同在營區等待除役而相識，種下了莫名的兄弟情誼巴宏為了完成軍中友人生前承諾，答應其女友伊莎貝爾，利用即將到來的聖誕長假潛入公司保險櫃放回一筆價值不菲的債券，波普也恰在同時找上巴宏，二人竟被鎖在公司金庫中！原來看似單純的偷天換日計劃其實是場大騙局，哥倆好陷入謀殺劫案中，該如何信守男人間的約定來扭轉頹勢？

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: 六八年夏天，姓高紗廠老闆敗賭而致家破人亡他的八歲兒子高進從此喪失家園，加入了老千集團跟靳學一切千門技術，十七歲已成為獨當一面的老千高手後來在一次賭神大賽中被師父出賣，並遭槍擊，好友七姑娘與于於在混戰當中受了重傷，高進在連番打擊下決定與師兄傲及靳在賭場上決一死戰

programme.title: 新少林五祖
programme.desc: 清朝康熙年間，少林俗家弟子洪熙官被同門師兄馬寧兒出賣，全家慘遭殺害，洪熙官刺死馬寧兒後，與唯一倖存的幼子浪跡天涯八年後，少林遭劫難，至菩禪師將藏寶圖紋在五個年幼的的俗家弟子背上，並委託洪熙官護送他們前往紅花會不料馬寧兒當年並沒有死，還成了刀槍不入的怪物，他殺害了紅花會總舵主，並追殺五個孩子

programme.title: 時光機器
programme.desc: 19世紀的英國發明家喬治搭著自己發明的時光機器前往未來，期盼未來會是和平世界，但實際上卻戰爭不斷當他來到最遙遠的未來，發現此時只剩下生活在地面的艾諾伊族，與生活在地底並以艾諾伊族為食的莫勒克族喬治挺身帶領艾諾伊族反抗，並協助他們重新建立文明

programme.title: 赤腳小子
programme.desc: 赤腳青年關豐曜進城投靠父親好友，卻意外捲入地方勢力爭鬥，最終為求出人頭地而付出慘痛代價與惡霸決一死戰

programme.title: 633轟炸大隊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，挪威反抗軍領袖艾利克冒死劫機逃至英國，帶來德軍在挪威秘密研發飛彈準備對盟軍展開致命攻擊的情報英軍命令格蘭特指揮官的蚊式戰鬥轟炸機633中隊，執行摧毀德軍隱身在挪威險峻峽灣飛彈工廠的任務艾利克奉命返回挪威帶領反抗軍破壞保護工廠的防空陣地，卻不幸被蓋世太保所擄並遭嚴刑拷問；消息傳回英國，為避免任務曝光急命633中隊全員出動救援

programme.title: 唐門之神犼雙雄
programme.desc: 唐門門主過世，二十年前的事再次掀起江湖紛爭，各方勢力針鋒相對，中原質子唐離與唐門少主唐天行，少女唐心陷入風暴的中心，一場圍繞兩個少年身世的秘密逐漸浮現，在各大門派的追殺中，二十年的武林大戰再次發生

programme.title: 哥吉拉
programme.desc: 潛伏自侏儸紀的大怪獸哥吉拉，突然地出現在東京沿海造成嚴重死傷生物學家山根博士原主張不予攻擊，但在目睹遍地瘡痍後終於認同消滅哥吉拉的行動最後在科學家芹澤犧牲自己使用秘密的氧氣破壞裝置後，與哥吉拉一同葬送在大海中

programme.title: 藍徽特攻隊
programme.desc: 一戰末期德軍在西部前線戰事吃緊，畢業於104飛行學校的史達赫中尉來到了威利上尉的飛行中隊當時飛行員最高榮譽是擊落敵機二十架可獲頒藍色徽章史達赫在首次任務就擊落英軍飛機一架，卻未得到陸軍證實而不算，但史達赫的戰功並未因此停滯不前；最終，史達赫榮獲最高榮譽，卻在授予藍色勳章那天，有人向元帥爆料史達赫紀錄不實的內幕，中隊長決定把他送至柏林軍事法庭究責

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 寧采臣是一名收帳書生，因雨被迫在一破廟留宿道士燕赤霞警告他儘快離開，寧未理會，後被古琴聲引至郊野而遇到女鬼聶小倩小倩為千年樹妖姥姥所控制，被迫引誘凡人予姥姥吸取元氣小倩為寧采臣真情所動，不願加害於他，然而姥姥欲將小倩嫁給黑山老妖寧采臣求助燕赤霞二人最終封印姥姥，又消滅黑山老妖，使小倩得以投胎轉世，燕赤霞亦決定回歸蘭若寺遠離塵世

programme.title: 登陸安齊奧
programme.desc: 1944年二戰盟軍關鍵的義大利戰役鵝卵石行動，決定在羅馬南邊的安齊奧登陸，搶灘卻出乎意料的輕而易舉負責領軍的萊斯里將軍懷疑有詐，遂命令全軍挖戰壕固守，殊不知德軍早將軍力移出戰地記者迪克駕吉普車長驅直入羅馬，立刻趕回告知羅馬已是空城，但將軍仍投鼠忌器，最後僅派出百餘人的突擊隊前往巡查而德軍亦開始緊急回防，盟軍幾成籠中鳥，南歐戰場最血腥的一役即將展開

programme.title: 新封神榜：楊戩
programme.desc: 商周之戰一千五百年後，天界衰落，蒙冤落魄的二郎神楊戩被迫封印天眼神通，只能以賞銀捕手為業謀生某日，一名神秘女子婉羅突然來訪，委託楊戩追捕一名竊取法寶的少年，而這名少年竟是楊戩許久未見的的親外甥沉香沉香立志尋回寶蓮燈以拯救被壓在華山蓮花峰下的母親，卻不知此舉將會釋放被鎮壓的滅世玄鳥，為天下蒼生帶來毀天滅地的災禍多方勢力紛紛現身插手，楊戩為了阻止沉香，竟意外揭開那塵封已久的秘密

programme.title: 蝙蝠俠1966
programme.desc: 高譚市四大惡徒：貓女企鵝人謎天大聖小丑，這次他們一起聯手結盟，駕著擁有洲際飛彈的企鵝核動力潛艇，劫持了一艘正駛往高譚市載有最新脫水科技儀器的遊艇這次，壞蛋們除了要除掉蝙蝠俠和羅賓的正義二人組外，最終目標是即將在高譚市召開的聯合國九大安理會員國會議，欲藉機控制全球！蝙蝠俠和羅賓該如何將四大惡徒繩之以法拯救世界呢？

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: 武功高強的唐龍，受朋友所託遠赴歐洲協助解決一家餐館的業權問題，遇上黑幫搗亂及威迫，並恥笑中國拳術，唐大怒出手把洋人打得抱頭鼠竄，黑幫首領大為震怒，最後請來美國國際空手道冠軍，與唐龍決一死戰

programme.title: 女王之家完
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 財閥家的小兒子
programme.desc: 年度收視冠軍！宋仲基轉生財閥金孫 上演經營權大戰出生貧寒的尹炫優，任職於順陽集團風險管理的秘書室長，對公司忠心耿耿，只要高層下達命令絕對使命必達，某天被指派回收秘密資金的任務，卻被集團誣陷私吞資金慘遭滅口再度睜開眼睛時，他回到了1987年，成為順陽集團的財閥金孫陳導俊，並利用前生的記憶，他將找出殺害他的兇手，更要加入繼承權爭奪戰，一步步併吞集團，成為順陽的新主人

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 李昇基韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子 高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星

programme.title: Bonjour麵包店
programme.desc: 車勝元金宣虎金喜愛強強聯手！全韓首間銀髮族專屬療癒咖啡廳 開幕當頂級影星遇上銀髮族長輩，一場最療癒的化學反應即將發生！Bonjour麵包店 將場景搬移至寧靜鄉村，打造全韓首間專屬長者的咖啡廳這裡不只販售甜點，更分享故事由金喜愛金宣虎組成超暖心服務組，用溫柔對話與親切笑容治癒每位長輩；廚房則由萬能主廚車勝元攜手李基澤，將在地食材化作精緻藝術品看這群大咖藝人如何陪伴長者細數人生軌跡，在麵包香氣中傳遞溫暖

programme.title: 男朋友雙語版
programme.desc: 韓版羅馬假期 霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍 出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首完
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 惜花芷
programme.desc: 世家千金經商勇敢為家族撐出一片天，張婧儀攜手胡一天立下終身之約！！京城望族花府忽遭抄家流放，被拆散的家族只徒留老弱婦孺守家門花家長女花芷從不過問家中世事，出面嶄露經商鋒芒撐起家中生計，帶著眾女重返家族光榮原以為自己不好惹的名聲傳遍京城將孤獨一生，遇見了七宿司司使顧晏惜成為彼此的救贖也向她許諾終身

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相

programme.title: 婚姻結業式2
programme.desc: 黃美惠當了28年的家庭主婦之後，終於和老公鎮邦達成卒婚的協議，搬出來自己住，但是初戀情人駱誠卻無法離開老婆，於是接受企業家林總的追求老公鎮邦幾經掙扎，終於遞出離婚協議書，美惠在確認綾香愛鎮邦之後，便與鎮邦離婚

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 夫婦的世界升級版！初戀女神現身 揭開五人幫隱藏面具一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學五人幫維持二十年的體面假象死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失嫉妒的丈夫被逼到絕境的妻子病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.desc: 水塑造了阿根廷北部的形狀，為獨特的野生動物創造了天堂無論是穿越瀑布的大烏雨燕在黑暗中發光的樹蛙矮樹叢中可愛的長鼻浣熊家族，或是四處覓食的巨型水蚺，阿根廷的濕地擁有許多奇觀

programme.title: 瞬間看車CAM英
programme.desc: 瞬間看車CAM，透過行車記錄儀展示各類駕駛事故，包括碰撞撞個稀巴爛與死神擦肩橫衝直撞，蒐集全球行車記錄儀的實況，這次展示艱難時期的駕駛經歷，會見到忘記如何駕駛的司機及其他精彩內容

programme.title: 節拍小天地英

programme.title: 火熱非洲英
programme.desc: 非洲有近乎無盡的生態系統財富，茂密潮濕的森林，酷熱乾燥的沙漠，在此廣袤大陸，貫穿東西南北的主宰是熱力第一集，探索獅子的乾燥稀樹草原，了解牠們如何在非洲酷熱地區求存

programme.title: 藍海世界英
programme.desc: 喬納森和家人一起去葡萄牙聖港島潛水在一天之內，先後探索了引人入勝的沉船看到一些有趣的動物行為享受晶瑩剔透的熱帶水域然後喬納森去訪問田納西水族館，了解館內的生物學家如何利用展館的魚卵養魚

programme.title: 七點半新聞報道英

programme.title: 唐人街探案3普

programme.title: 龍虎風雲粵

programme.title: 殭屍家族粵
programme.desc: 古董商郭敦煌鍾發飾在古墓中盜走了三具殭屍,意外弄醒殭屍父張榮祥飾,母王玉環飾並不慎放走了小殭屍何健威飾而招禍,中醫師林正英林正英飾發現奕豬膽樓南光飾身中屍毒,故與其女兒阿芝李賽鳳飾及記者男友夏友仁元彪飾尋找殭屍下落.女童嘉嘉韓詩雨飾誤會小殭屍是人蛇,收留房中並成為好友.其父胡胡楓飾發現後大驚,遂向警方求助,怎料殭屍父母竟殺入胡家.

programme.title: 靠近我一點普
programme.desc: 等了初戀男友10年的林楚楚春夏 飾,最後等來的是男友和別人的婚禮.正當她對感情失去信心的時候,婚禮策劃師張揚張震 飾和高富帥男神於可風李現 飾同時出現在楚楚的生活中,陪她走出了這段黑暗時光.只活一次的人生,一定要和真正愛的人有個美好的結局.面對同樣真摯的兩個人,楚楚的感情也來到了必須抉擇的十字路口,這次楚楚想要跟命運賭一把,不留遺憾勇敢愛.

programme.title: 行運一條龍粵普
programme.desc: 行運茶餐廳是一間傳統港式茶餐廳,其中招牌蛋撻及奶茶更是賣到街知巷聞.茶餐廳李老板吳孟達飾獨力撫養獨生子得男陳曉東飾,茶餐廳中年資最老的阿水周星馳飾不但係茶餐廳專家,亦是眾所週知的情場聖手...

programme.title: 無雙粵普
programme.desc: 偽鈔畫師李問在泰國因製作假鈔,遭人密報被捕入獄.香港警方將他引渡回港,當律政司要檢控之際,國寶級畫家阮文前來保釋,雙方達成協議 - 如果李問能夠供出偽鈔集團主腦畫家真正身份,便可轉為污點證人.故事開始追溯至1985年的溫哥華,李問跟阮文本是一對情侶畫家,其後阮文的作品受人欣賞且擁有專屬經紀人,然而李問卻因為作品原創性不足,只能靠偷偷製作仿真畫維生.有回無意間被阮文戳破,雙方起了爭執,兩人漸行...

programme.title: 性工作者2:我不賣身我賣子宮粵普
programme.desc: 黎鐘鐘滿口爛牙,染上毒癮,每天站在深水土步街頭,搵客賣肉賺錢.在黑暗人生背後,她希望39歲之時,可以脫離企街,重過新生活,偏偏命運安排她遇上另一個女人.黃蓮花嫁港伯生仔,出賣肚皮換取居港權,拿綜援的內地女人.本以為生仔之後,可來港享特權,嘆世界,偏偏丈夫因工逝世,全盤計劃被受破壞...

programme.title: 圍城粵普
programme.desc: 何靈傑外表就如一般天水圍的學生一樣,可是他比一眾學生勤奮好學,力爭上游,為著沖出天水圍的目標而奮鬥.除此以外,他對所有無關於己的事情漠不關心.靈傑來至一個不健全的問題家庭,除了要照顧患有精神病的母親,還要面對嗜賭的暴力父親,此外,靈傑還有一個離家出走多年的弟弟俊傑...

programme.title: 愛您愛到殺死您粵普
programme.desc: 歌星朱金梅受廣大歌迷愛戴,經理人契媽卻接二連三收到對金梅之死亡死嚇,警方派出年輕正氣警員黎樹根假扮同性戀,暗中保護金梅,二人身份攪出笑話百出.樹根與金梅歷幾番折騰後互生情愫.在金梅演唱會首晚,真正的瘋狂歌迷突然出現,原來這歌迷因愛成恨,要把金梅殺死...

programme.title: 愛作戰粵
programme.desc: 情侶家銳陳奕迅飾與靖儂周麗淇飾感情穩定,過著平淡的生活.為了給這段關係帶來新衝擊,二人決定自費到歐洲旅行,不幸出發當日家銳的車被偷,二人吵了起來並道出對對方多年來的不滿,靖儂一氣之下提出分手...

programme.title: 一路狂奔普
programme.desc: 某地產集團高層許德才被迫出逃.與其有曖昧關係的女老闆趙冰要求他背黑鍋,給他兩個選擇:一是逃跑,二是死.許德才逃亡途中路遇昔日的朋友王小兵借錢給女兒看病.隨後王小兵被人毆打,導致許德才丟了箱子,他的證件和機票在箱中,於是兩人開始尋找箱子...

programme.title: 猜猜我是誰普
programme.desc: 以社會話題的電話詐騙案為題材,阿海與阿芳經營一個跨越中港泰三地的詐騙集團,集團擁有大量銀行卡及客戶資料,中港兩地遍佈提取現金的網絡,只要設在泰國的總部打出電話,幾萬至幾十萬的詐騙金在數十分鐘內即可滾滾而來.為了對付這個龐大的詐騙集團,警方設立了一個反詐騙的專案小組,以電腦科技追蹤詐騙金下落.女特警小兔混入遠在泰國的詐騙集團,而警員丁小田與小兔裡應外合,專案組與詐騙集團展開層層緊扣的反詐智鬥,...

programme.title: 暴瘋語粵普

Filled with hero worship for the daring pilots of the Battle of Britain, he dreamed of roaming the clouds in such a thrilling machine. As a student, he was selected to join the RAF air reserve squadron and to his delight, when the time came for him to do National Service, was accepted for pilot training in the RAF. programme.desc: Kate MacLeod, aka The Hebridean Mermaid, explores the hidden gems of the Hebrides, meeting tradition bearers with remarkable stories about the places she loves to visit the most, above and below the water. In this episode she comes across an interesting sea creature, known as a sunfish, which is native to tropical waters, but is likely to have been carried to the islands by the Gulf Stream. Swimming on its side, the sun heats its body and it feeds on jellyfish. She also journeys to Taransay, home of some of the most stunning and unique beaches in the Outer Hebrides. Once a thriving community, the island had three villages, but is now home to deer, seabirds and cattle.

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Horticulturist Christine Walkden embarks on a journey to explore some of the most impressive gardens in the UK - from a hot-air balloon. In the first edition, she hovers above Cornwall, and finds herself overwhelmed with nostalgia by the giant Brazilian gunnera. Later, she meets a man whose childhood was spent playing in the garden, before testing her nerves at St Michaels Mount where she encounters gardening on the edge

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: To mark World Rivers Day, Matt Baker and Margherita Taylor explore the River Trent and the land that surrounds it. Once heavily engineered and polluted, the river is now becoming a testbed for new approaches to improving its condition. Plus, Margherita follows a project to reintroduce white storks to the Trent Valley, and Joe Crowley investigates what the rapid growth of AI data centres could mean for the countryside

programme.title: Landward

Leanna Fernandez joins a team ringing red kite chicks and finds out how the bird of prey has become a conservation success story. Continuing her journey round the Buchan coast, Rachel Bell drops by a Peterhead business that has been smoking fish for centuries, while Rosie Morton visits the walled garden near Laurencekirk where investors buy into a fruit and veg stock market

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking

He also remembers a mysterious clifftop hideaway in Gower during a walk from Fall Bay to Oxwich, and looks back his time in the Wye Valley, where took to the water in a canoe and visited Tintern Abbey during a remarkable archaeological excavation

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France

She also meets young chefs leading a new food scene that blends French technique with global influences, including Mory Sacko at MoSuke and Hanz Gueco at Le Cheval dOr

programme.title: Lorraine Pascale: How to Be a Better Cook

Lorraine creates a Chinese-inspired menu of dishes that are simple to prepare, including sweet-and-sour ribs, chicken and cashew nut stir fry and a showstopping cake

programme.title: Nigel and Adams Farm Kitchen
programme.desc: Culinary writer Nigel Slater and Countryfile presenter Adam Henson follow the journey of more fresh food from farm to fork. They focus on chicken, the UKs favourite meat, which appears on almost every restaurant and takeaway menu in the country. Nigel visits eateries in Manchester for inspiration on spicing up his recipes back in the kitchen at the Cotswolds farm, before demonstrating a few alternatives to shoppers favourites such as chicken Kievs and avocado dips. Meanwhile, Adam accepts the ultimate farming challenge - to grow exotic crops like rice and Asian mushrooms for a selection of international dishes

programme.title: Rugby League Grand Final Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the Super League Grand Final, which came from Old Trafford. The Wolves played away to Leeds Rhinos in the semi-finals, and Wigan hosted Wakefield Trinity

programme.title: The Man Who Would Be King

However, his growing delusions of grandeur put him at loggerheads with his comrade-in-arms. Adventure based on the Rudyard Kipling story, directed by John Huston, starring Sean Connery, Michael Caine, Saeed Jaffrey, Christopher Plummer and Shakira Caine.

programme.title: This Farming Life

On top of all that, imports of foreign lamb threaten profit margins for his lamb fattening business. In Moray, Nikki and Ollie pick up a big order from their local butcher. Theyre showcasing and selling their buffalo meat and other home-grown produce at a Christmas farmers market

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France

Eva then heads out into the sun-kissed landscape to try the traditional summer vegetable dish of ratatouille and a sun-drenched salad nioise on the Riviera at the famous Hotel du Cap

programme.title: Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

The baby birds follow the grown-ups so they know where to go, and then they remember the way for the rest of their lives. programme.title: Horsey Ride
programme.desc: When Bluey forgets to put her favourite toy away, Socks grabs it! The kids stage a horsey wedding to distract her, with Dad and Uncle Stripe as the horses!

programme.title: Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the governments secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperors ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fte. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion, threatening the couples union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen Lin Chong gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her masters Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fans daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fans friend along the way.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber 1961
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fangs fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Mings guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nus elder sister hopes to restore the clans honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the others true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Mad Monk 1993
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Yis LiLi-est Fan
programme.desc: While Everest is going through some typical teenager growing pains not wanting to brush his teeth or tidy his room, a welcome distraction comes in the form of LiLi, an adorable nine-year-old whos positively obsessed with Yi, Everest, and the crews pursuits. When Everest doesnt return from a sweets-filled outing with LiLi, the crew discovers LiLis intentions might not have been so pure.

programme.title: Misconcepted Deceptions
programme.desc: Birch manages to convince Liam that Sandras grade-threatening bad mood stems from boy trouble. In an effort to get her out of her funk and into studying again, the cousins invent a secret admirer for Sandra. They soon find Sandras constant need for affirmation exhausting a further complication in their attempt to keep up their group grade point average.

programme.title: Reach For The Pod
programme.desc: When Sandra signs Pod 4 up for an academic quiz show, the kids are soon figuring out how to best leverage their TV exposure. It soon becomes obvious that four separate agenda do not add up to a cohesive team as they suffer near humiliation at the hands of the preppie team from Rydell High.

programme.title: Big Man On Canvas
programme.desc: Raffis win at the district art show hurtles Birch into the five stages of grief, her reactions throwing her podmates for a loop. Luckily, Liams hip to whats going on thanks to a book Mr. Towes has assigned him. While Sandra trails Liam in hopes of seeing some emotional fireworks on Birchs part, Raffi cant quite get over the idea that Birch wouldnt be happy for his success.

programme.title: The Pencil Assassin
programme.desc: Birch is initially aghast when Jason publishes her Manga sample in the school paper, but soon succumbs to the allure of popularity. As Birchs social status soars, her podmates become laughingstocks. Sandras retaliation eventually brings the two girls together in their fight against the unethical editor of The Cosmos Chronicle.

programme.title: Olivia Trains Her Cat
programme.desc: When Olivias class holds a pet talent show, nobody can beat Francines amazingly talented cat Gwendolyn. Olivias lethargic cat Edwin, who barely moves, suddenly goes missing. Olivia then fancies herself a cat detective as shetracks down the missing cat.

programme.title: Olivias Lemonade Stand
programme.desc: Olivias lemonade stand is losing customers to Francines pink lemonade stand. Olivia does her one better by opening up her own full-scale backyard restaurant, imagining its a fabulous supper club. But Olivia soon finds that her restaurant needs something she can only get from Francine something pink!

programme.title: Olivia Takes A Road Trip
programme.desc: On the looooong drive to Grandmas house, Olivia finds ways to pass the time. She imagines her family traveling in style, as she pilots her very own jumbo jetOlivia Air! By the time they arrive at Grandmas, Olivias had so much fun that the discomfort of the road trip has been forgotten.

programme.title: Olivia Goes International
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her classs International Day. Olivia cant decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: The Cleat without Feet Real Magic
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harpers soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his magic hat, they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylans magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Tanakas Moving Castle Zenko Dont Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sams skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlams comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Driven to Distraction To Bee or Not To Bee
programme.desc: When easily-distracted Luis is tasked with getting flowers for his grandmothers birthday party, TZG secretly keeps him on track. When Rodneys honey bees escape from their apiary artificial beehive, TZG secretly brings them back.

programme.title: Bully For You The Ra Animator
programme.desc: Bully For You When Casper decides he cant take any more of Thatchs nastiness, he forms a secret squad dedicated to putting an end to bullying. The Ra-minator Using the power of invisibility, Casper offers to help transform Ra from a sports zero to an athletic hero.

programme.title: Weekend At Bunnys Grimly Day
programme.desc: Weekend at Bunnys Alder and Dash sound the alarm after a terrifying creature threatens Scare School. Grimly Day Its Grimly Day?the grimmest day of the year!

programme.title: A Cat-Tabulous Christmas
programme.desc: Its Christmas time in the dollhouse! After putting the final topper on the Christmas tree, Figgy the Elf calls and says that Santa Kitty needs help in his workshop, its up to Gabby and Pandy to go help her out. After some toy fixing and boxing fun, Gabby and Pandy get to meet Santa Kitty and his Kitty reindeer and join him delivering presents to all their friends in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd who thinks its the best kitty toy ever! gets his paws on it!

programme.title: The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. When Captain Meow Meow gets a splinter in his paw and hears the word vet, he flees. Now its up to the Dew Drops to find Captain Meow Meow and get that splinter out.

programme.title: Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harpers drone flies away its up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylans first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Little Sisters Tricky Treasure
programme.desc: Kelp and Pixie forget about their little sisters and their plans to hang out. Scallop goes to Unicorn Land and meets Juniper. They play and become friends. The unicorns are eager to play with a new mystery item that washes up on the beach, but what is it? While the other unicorns come up with imaginative ideas of what it could be, Pixie is determined to find out exactly what it is.

programme.title: Crabby Spe-shell
programme.desc: When Pixies pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. Scallops special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: Twintuition
programme.desc: When the Twins journey to the Northern Markets to fix their prized mace, they end up stumbling onto a secret project by Viggo and the Dragon Hunters.

programme.title: Blindsided

But their paths cross and their lives are intertwined by one common factor: All 3 are former criminals who have been cuffed for life by society.

programme.title: 超级冰冰ShowSuper Bing Bing Show
programme.desc: 超级冰冰 Show是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 听！台湾在唱歌 2Listen! Taiwan Sings 2
programme.desc: 第二季的节目由旺福乐团主唱姚小民首次担纲主持，背着吉他走访台湾各地，与歌手来宾一同探索在地文化与音乐故事他以音乐人的独特视角重新诠释经典歌曲，透过真诚而温暖的旅程，带领观众感受台湾的人文风情与土地魅力新世代的金奖歌手，将走唱更多老歌及在地故事Hosted by Wonfus frontman Yao Xiao Min, this season travels across Taiwan with award-winning guest artistes, reimagining classic songs and uncovering local stories through music. A heartfelt journey celebrating Taiwans people and heritage.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 超级夜总会Super Nightclub
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的超级夜总会，佳乐台抢先火速送上

programme.title: 超級紅人榜Top Singers
programme.desc: 难得一见以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！超级红人榜的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 爱的勘探法Exploration Method of Love
programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌Memorable Classic Songs

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第二季Earthly Ambrosia S2
programme.desc: 延续上一季亦庄亦谐的风格，第二季以南北物产为出发点，延伸至各地的自然景观和人文风貌，最终呈现人与食物的故事Showcasing local produce from the north and south, this second series extends to the natural landscapes and cultures of the regions, ultimately presenting the stories of the people and their food.

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Petunjuk baharu dalam pencarian Alia untuk menemukan Laila membawanya semakin hampir kepada kebenaran. Ketika kisah silam terbongkar, Shafiq berdepan persimpangan, manakala kehidupan dalam pelarian mendedahkan Imran dan Laila kepada niat tersembunyi serta bahaya baharu.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Alia mula mendapat kepercayaan seseorang yang mungkin memegang kunci kepada kisah silam Laila, sementara keadaan Uwan yang semakin merosot membuatkan keluarganya berada dalam kebimbangan. Harapan Imran dan Laila untuk memulakan hidup baharu turut terancam.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa mula mencari maklumat tentang AR Holdings. Fendi pula mula membuat video tentang produk AR Holdings yang memberi kesan negative kepada para pengguna. Siti mengalami kemalangan dan memerlukan darah. Muhammad yang masih belum mengetahui identiti ibu kepada Arissa menawarkan diri untuk menderma darah. Arissa melihat akan kebaikan Muhammad dan mula berubah fikiran terhadap Muhammad.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan tidak bersetuju dengan cadangan Antasya dan menjelaskan niatnya. Syarfan terharu melihat Antasya yang sarat mengadug gigih membantu Talia yang semakin teruk keadaanya menguruskan diri. Alia enggan menjaga Talia. Nazarin menuduh Alia tidak professional dan tidak layak menjadi nurse.

programme.title: Cek Ombak
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kika dan Igo, sepasang kekasih yang bertemu melalui aplikasi kencan, namun menghadapi komplikasi rumit ketika orang tua mereka menikah. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh ikatan persaudaraan tiri dan penolakan orang tua.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Tengku Maria menjadi semakin bimbang melihat keadaan Iskandar yang semakin tidak bermaya dan tidak terurus. Dia minta Haziq untuk kembali ke Kuala Lumpur dan menasihati Iskandar, namum Haziq enggan pulang selagi dia tidak dapat membawa Aisyah pulang bersama. Haziq juga masih terluka dengan ungkitan yang disebut oleh Iskandar tentang asal usulnya. Iskandar masih menanti dan sentiasa mencari Aisyahy, setiap malam dia bermimpi akan Aisyah yang datang menemuinya dan kembali semula ke kondo itu. Iskandar kesal, dia nekad untuk menebus segala khilafnya sekiranya Aisyah kembali kepadanya. Aisyah masih enggan pulang ke Kuala Lumpur, dia bertegas bahawa dia tidak mengenali Haziq dan sesiapa di Kuala Lumpur itu. Anim dan Azri cuba meyakinkan Aisyah namun sering kali gagal. Tanpa diduga, Rokiah dan Sarip berat hati untuk melepaskan Aisyah pergi. Di sebalik layanan baik Rokiah dan Sarip terhadap Aisyah, sebenarnya mereka pernah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka ketika berusia 6 tahun akibat kemalangan jalan raya. disebabkan itu mereka sangat menyanyangi Aisyah dan bersyukur ingatan Aisyah membolehkan Aisyah kembali kepada memori dia bersama arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk memberitahu hal itu kepada Tengku Maria, berita itu membuatkan Tengku Maria gembira dan tidak sabar untuk menyambut kepulangan Aisyah. Namun Haziq tidak memberitahu perihal ingatan Aisyah yang sudah hilang memorinya. Anim, Azri, Rokiah, Sarip dan Amani bersetuju untuk bersama membawa Aisyah ke Kuala Lumpur demi menjamin keselamatan Aisyah dan kejujuran Haziq yang mahu Aisyah pulang ke Kuala Lumpur.

Dan berita ini juga membuatkan Aisyah meroyan dan terus ke rumah Alawiyah untuk meyakinkan Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu dan apabila Jazlan sampai dari Mesir Aisyah terus meluru masuk ke rumah Alawiyah dan sekali lagi meminta Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu bukan Qasih. Jazlan pula teringat akan kata-kata Qasih semasa memarahi beliau kerana bersetuju untuk berkahwin dengannya lalu Jazlan terus memaklumkan kepada ibunya untuk membatalkan pernikahannya dengan Qasih

programme.title: Ia Wujud
programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang
programme.desc: Darma trauma dengan bunuh diri tunangnya, Rose, yang telah dihantui oleh makhluk halus jahat. Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Terkejut dengan kejadian bunuh diri itu, Darma bekerjasama dengan adik kembar Rose, Seri, untuk menyiasat. Semasa mereka menyiasat, pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku, menyebabkan keadaan mental Darma semakin merosot dan memberi kesan kepada kerjayanya. Dia pulang ke kampung untuk berehat, tanpa disedari semakin hampir dengan kebenaran. Akhirnya, terungkap bahawa nenek Darma secara tidak sengaja telah mengundang roh yang dikenali sebagai Saka ke dalam rumah mereka, satu roh yang menghantui keturunan pemiliknya selepas kematian.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Dacademy 7
programme.desc: D Academy 7 ialah musim ketujuh rancangan nyanyian popular Indonesia yang fokus pada muzik dangdut. Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

programme.title: Hi Guys
programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Tumbang Setelah Mencoba Mengalahkan Prime Neng Pasar
programme.desc: Devan Farhan Rasyid, seorang mahasiswa yang sedang menyiapkan tesis tentang komuniti pasar, bertemu Alya Adzwa Aurell, seorang pemandu lori wanita ketika menjalankan kajiannya. Selepas pertemuan mereka berakhir dengan pertelingkahan, Devan terpaksa menyamar untuk mendekati Alya semula tanpa diketahui identiti sebenarnya.

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Qari Cilik Season 3
programme.desc: Qari Cilik Indonesia kembali untuk musim ketiga, menampilkan kanak-kanak berbakat dalam seni tilawah Al-Quran. Saksikan perjalanan para peserta muda dalam menyampaikan bacaan yang indah dan penuh makna.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati

programme.title: Undian Memang Salah Tapi Hasilnya Kita Berjodoh
programme.desc: Julia yang mengetahui dirinya akan dijodohkan dengan Bimo, nekad melarikan diri dari rumah menaiki motosikal. Dia meminta bantuan sahabatnya, Iis, untuk merancang helah sepanjang pelariannya. Sementara itu, Bimo mengejar Julia dengan menaiki lori bersama rakan-rakannya sambil menjerit meminta Julia berhenti. Adakah Julia dan Bimo berjodoh akhirnya?

programme.title: Gaspol
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan permainan yang menghiburkan dengan pelbagai hadiah dan ganjaran wang tunai.

programme.title: MISS FORTUNE
programme.desc: Swindler Ji-Hye is looking to make her last big score. Together with her daughter, they infiltrate the house of a cultural property broker with a net worth of 60 billion won.

programme.title: SPIRITWALKER
programme.desc: A man loses memory and wakes up in a new body every 12 hours. In search of his identity, he met a woman who claims to know him.

programme.title: THE SWINDLERS
programme.desc: Though each has their own motives, unlikely individuals from different sides of the law allies together to achieve a common goal - trapping the worlds most legendary con man.

programme.title: PICNIC
programme.desc: Eun-sim is an elderly living alone in Seoul. She heads to her hometown after decades away. Her long-lost memories come to life one by one. This could be the start of one last picnic...

programme.title: A MAN OF REASON
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a man learns that he has a daughter, thus wishes to leave the gangs and live an ordinary life. Yet the new leader of the gangs feels being betrayed...

programme.title: THE WAY HOME
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang-woo, a spoiled city boy, is sent to live with his mute grandmother in a remote rural village. Cut off from modern comforts, he slowly adapts as a quiet bond begins to form.

programme.title: ONE WIN
programme.desc: Woo-jin is the newly appointed manager of a girls volleyball team which is going to disband. The new owner sold all ace players for money and asked the team to win at least once.

programme.title: SPLIT
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: THE KING
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90s Korea.

programme.title: NO OTHER CHOICE
programme.desc: After being laid off, Man-su spends a year attending interviews and working at retail store. He cannot get back to the industry so he comes to a decision that will bring him a job...

programme.title: ONCE WE WERE US
programme.desc: Former lovers Eun-ho and Jeong-won unexpectedly reunite on a flight to Korea, giving them a second chance to reminisce about their past and share long-buried words with each other.

programme.title: COLLECTORS
programme.desc: A legendary treasure hidden in Seouls royal tomb sparks fierce rivalry as the exacavators and others with secret agendas race to outwit each other for the kings relics. Who will prevail?

programme.title: MISSING YOU
programme.desc: When Hee-Joo was 7 years old, her father was murdered. The killer, Ki-Bum, was eventually arrested. Hee-Joo has waited patiently for Ki-Bums release.

programme.title: STEAL MY HEART
programme.desc: Hot-shot police detective Lee is out to get a hit-and-run driver and discovers the driver is his long-lost girlfriend from ten years ago. He tries to protect her before her crime record accumulates.

programme.title: GYEONG-AHS DAUGHTER
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma...

programme.title: CONCRETE UTOPIA
programme.desc: Seoul lies in ruins after an earthquake, leaving a single apartment still standing. The apartments resident representative strives to protect the residents from outsiders...

programme.title: DARK NUNS
programme.desc: An evil spirit possesses a boy and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences.

programme.title: GATE
programme.desc: A group of five conspired for one last heist, yet secrets inside the vault are large enough to overthrow the country.

programme.title: THE WHISTLEBLOWER

programme.title: THE SNITCH
programme.desc: Kang-soo was falsely accused and imprisoned. A prosecutor offered him a deal to be a snitch in exchange for a reduced sentence and Kang-soo starts to shake up the drug investigation...

programme.title: THE HOT-BLOODED

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Thai Rogered Sr.11
programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts,

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, Group friend listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?
